subtitle: High-resolution commercial workhorses & next-gen mobile video capture

items.name: Sony a7IV
items.spec: 33MP Full-Frame Exmor R CMOS, BIONZ XR, 4K60p 10-bit 4:2:2, 15+ stops DR. Primary body for low-light bar and atmospheric beverage work.

items.name: Sony a7CR
items.spec: 61MP Ultra-Compact Full-Frame, Dedicated AI Autofocus Processing Unit, Pixel Shift Multi Shooting. Dedicated to detail-critical cocktail close-ups and high-res print stills.

items.name: iPhone 17 Pro Max
items.spec: 48MP Fusion quad-pixel sensor, Apple Log 2 ProRes 4K120 fps, anti-reflective optical coating. Next-gen primary handheld mobile video capture and run-and-gun social reels.

items.name: iPhone 15 Pro Max
items.spec: 48MP Main with 24mm/28mm/35mm framing, 5x 120mm tetraprism telephoto, direct USB-C ProRes Log to NVMe SSD. Ultra-reliable pocket B-cam and fast-turnaround vertical stories.
items.imageAlt: Apple iPhone 15 Pro Max Natural Titanium

items.name: iPhone 12 Pro Max
items.spec: 12MP sensor-shift stabilization, Dolby Vision HDR 10-bit recording, LiDAR scanner. Dedicated static overhead cocktail prep and secondary reference angle backup.

subtitle: G Master zoom trilogy and ultra-sharp low-light prime optics

items.name: Sony FE 24-70mm f/2.8 GM
items.spec: Workhorse standard zoom. Extreme flare resistance in dark bar environments and razor-sharp resolution across the focal range.

items.name: Sony FE 16-35mm f/2.8 GM II
items.spec: Ultra-wide zoom. Architecturally straight interiors, ambient venue establishing shots, and dramatic bar counter perspective.
items.imageAlt: Sony FE 16-35mm f/2.8 GM II Lens

items.name: Sony FE 70-200mm f/2.8 GM II
items.spec: Telephoto zoom with legendary optical compression. Cocktail pours and candid bartender portraits captured without crowding the bar.
items.imageAlt: Sony FE 70-200mm f/2.8 GM II Lens

items.name: Sony FE 90mm f/2.8 Macro G OSS
items.spec: True 1:1 macro reproduction. Razor-sharp condensation droplets, carbonation bubbles, and intricate cocktail garnish textures.
items.imageAlt: Sony FE 90mm f/2.8 Macro G OSS Lens

items.name: Sony FE 55mm f/1.8 ZA Sonnar
items.spec: Zeiss optical formula with legendary 3D pop and micro-contrast. Low-light bar favorite with creamy out-of-focus background rolloff.
items.imageAlt: Sony FE 55mm f/1.8 ZA Sonnar Lens

items.name: Sony FE 50mm f/2.5 G
items.spec: Ultra-compact all-metal prime. Dual linear AF motors, aperture ring with de-click switch, perfect for lightweight handheld shoots.

items.name: Sony FE 24mm f/2.8 G
items.spec: Ultra-compact wide prime. Matched form factor with the 50mm G, ideal for gimbal balancing and tight prep-table clearances.

items.name: Viltrox AF 85mm f/2.0 EVO
items.spec: Short telephoto portrait prime with STM stepping motor and creamy bokeh. Ideal for cinematic beverage isolation.

subtitle: Studio point-source LED and radio wireless flash

items.name: Aputure Amaran 200d
items.spec: 200W Daylight (5600K) point-source LED, Bowens mount, 65,000 lux @ 1m with reflector. Key light for commercial beverage and tabletop setups.

items.name: Sony HVL-F60RM2
items.spec: GN60 high-output wireless radio flash, Quick Shift Bounce system, 20-200mm motorized zoom head, high-speed sync (HSS) with reliable multi-flash TTL.

subtitle: Carbon fiber travel legs, heavy-duty C-stands, and high-capacity battery systems

items.name: Peak Design Carbon Fiber Tripod
items.spec: Ultra-compact zero-wasted-volume design, integrated ball head with Arca-Swiss quick-release, fast cam-lever leg deployment for mobile bar scouting.
items.imageAlt: Peak Design Carbon Fiber Travel Tripod

items.name: Kupo Steel C-Stands & Grip Arms
items.spec: Heavy-duty chrome-plated steel turtle base C-stands with 40-inch grip arms and 2.5-inch grip heads for overhead cocktail cameras and boom light positioning.
items.imageAlt: Kupo Steel Master C-Stands and Grip Arms

items.name: Sony NP-FZ100 Z-Series Battery
items.spec: High-capacity 2280mAh InfoLITHIUM rechargeable battery pack powering Sony a7IV and a7CR bodies through intensive full-day commercial shoots.
